fusions.name: Twin Quill
fusions.desc: Flings a sharp scale that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Wide Berth
fusions.desc: Splays your scales outward in a wide fan, dealing 15 damage to every enemy in front of you out to 5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Parting Guard
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 22% and your dodge chance by 10% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Branching Strike
fusions.desc: Each time you strike, a second bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 9 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Your armour is 6% higher at all times. Once every 4 seconds.
